inclusions.text: Your own Egyptologist guide and driver
inclusions.source: It is two days, privately operated, with your own Egyptologist guide and driver.

itinerary.title: South to Aswan and its monuments
itinerary.source: The shape is simple: south to Aswan and its monuments on day one; out to Abu Simbel and back on day two, with a return option that leaves you in Aswan, at the airport, or back in Luxor depending on what comes next.

itinerary.title: Out to Abu Simbel and back
itinerary.source: The shape is simple: south to Aswan and its monuments on day one; out to Abu Simbel and back on day two, with a return option that leaves you in Aswan, at the airport, or back in Luxor depending on what comes next.
